# FPGASNNMemoryOptimization

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware-aware technique that uses vector quantization to compress synaptic weights and spike activity in FPGA-implemented spiking neural networks. Addresses the primary bottleneck of on-chip memory in neuromorphic accelerators, improving feasibility of large-scale iNEST deployments.
